# 2418. Sort the People

## Solution 1 (time O(nlog(n)), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def sortPeople(self, names, heights):
        """
        :type names: List[str]
        :type heights: List[int]
        :rtype: List[str]
        """
        return map(lambda x: x[1], sorted(zip(heights, names), reverse = True))
```
